map.按术式查询典型手术时长范围，支持多术式叠加估算总时长，辅助手术排台与日程规划。: Look up typical duration ranges by procedure, combine multiple procedures to estimate a total, and support room scheduling and calendar planning.
map.排台前将多个术式的最短时间/最长时间相加，得到整台手术的最短、预计与最长时长区间: Before scheduling, add up the shortest and longest times of several procedures to get the shortest, expected, and longest total duration of the whole operating list, for room scheduling and turnover planning.
map.开启接台模式后，叠加每台术前准备、术后复苏与台间清洁时间（清洁只计 n−1 次）: With turnover mode on, add per-case pre-op preparation, post-op recovery, and inter-case cleaning (cleaning counted only n−1 times) for a more realistic occupancy.
map.在预计时长基础上预留 15% 缓冲（如接台合计 420 分钟留 63 分钟缓冲）: Add a 15% buffer to the expected duration (63 minutes on a 420-minute turnover total) to absorb intraoperative variation and avoid delays in back-to-back cases.
map.示例：两台手术 60–90 分与 120–180 分，接台准备 30 / 复苏: Example: two surgeries at 60–90 and 120–180 minutes, with turnover preparation 30, recovery 60, and cleaning 15
map.：时长合计 最短 180、预计 225、最长 270 分；接台耗时 = 30×2: : total duration is 180 shortest, 225 expected, 270 longest minutes; turnover time = 30×2 + 60×2 + 15×1 = 195 minutes; overall 375 shortest / 420 expected / 465 longest minutes; a 15% buffer is about 63 minutes, giving about 483 minutes with buffer (8 hours 3 minutes).
map.为什么用最短/预计/最长三段而非单一数值？: Why Use Shortest/Expected/Longest Instead of a Single Number?
map.手术时长受麻醉、粘连、出血量等影响波动大，给出区间比单点估计更稳妥，便于排台留余: Surgical duration varies widely with anesthesia, adhesions, and blood loss, so a range is more reliable than a single point estimate and leaves margin when scheduling.
map.清洁时间为什么只算 n−1 次？: Why Is Cleaning Counted Only n−1 Times?
map.n 台手术之间有 n−1 个台间清洁间隔，首台前无需清洁、末台后由复苏衔接，因此: There are n−1 inter-case cleaning gaps among n surgeries — no cleaning is needed before the first case, and recovery bridges the last one — so inter-case cleaning is counted only n−1 times.
